name: lic01-licence
check: f=server/src/studio/licence.rs; for s in 'OpenRAIL licence, check its use restrictions' 'non-commercial licence"' 'unknown licence, check it before use' 'LIC-01'; do grep -qF "$s" $f || { echo "error: $f: missing $s"; exit 1; }; done; ! grep -n 'refused\|Kees' $f | sed 's/^/error: server\/src\/studio\/licence.rs: still says refused or Kees: /' | grep .  && cd server && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/home/khyretos/Docker/Personal-projects/kreative-kompanion/server/target timeout 900 nice cargo test -q --lib studio::licence 2>&1
check_errors: error: server/src/studio/licence.rs: still says refused or Kees: 1://! Which model licences get a warning (LIC-01: a warning only, nothing is refused): OSI/CC0 none, CC-BY without attribution, the rest yes.

name: lic01-queue
check: f=server/src/studio/mod.rs; grep -q 'Refused licences' $f && { echo "error: $f: the refusal block is still there"; exit 1; }; grep -q 'let runnable = true;' $f || { echo "error: $f: runnable is not true"; exit 1; }; grep -q 'it never stops a run (LIC-01)' $f || { echo "error: $f: module doc line 3 not changed"; exit 1; }; cd server && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/home/khyretos/Docker/Personal-projects/kreative-kompanion/server/target timeout 900 nice cargo check -q 2>&1

name: lic01-wftests
check: f=server/src/studio/workflow.rs; grep -q 'never refused' $f || { echo "error: $f: doc comment not changed"; exit 1; }; grep -q 'licence_warnings().is_empty()' $f && { echo "error: $f: repo test still asserts no warnings"; exit 1; }; for t in 'fn licences()' 'fn load()' 'fn repo_workflows_all_load()'; do grep -qF "$t" $f || { echo "error: $f: test $t missing"; exit 1; }; done; cd server && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/home/khyretos/Docker/Personal-projects/kreative-kompanion/server/target timeout 900 nice cargo test -q studio:: 2>&1

name: lic01-capcard
check: grep -qF '"licence warning" : "ready"' web/src/views/capabilities.ts || { echo "error: web/src/views/capabilities.ts: missing licence warning : ready"; exit 1; }; grep -qF 's-${w.problems.length ? "needs_input" : "done"}' web/src/views/capabilities.ts || { echo "error: web/src/views/capabilities.ts: missing s-${w.problems.length ? needs_input : done}"; exit 1; }; grep -qF 'wf-problems">licence warning: ${w.problems.join' web/src/views/capabilities.ts || { echo "error: web/src/views/capabilities.ts: missing wf-problems>licence warning: ${w.problems.join"; exit 1; }; cd web && timeout 300 npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1

name: lic01-studiotype
check: grep -qF 'warning?: string;' web/src/views/studio.ts || { echo "error: web/src/views/studio.ts: missing warning?: string;"; exit 1; }; grep -qF 'class="small studio-warning">Licence warning: ${t.warning}' web/src/views/studio.ts || { echo "error: web/src/views/studio.ts: missing class=small studio-warning>Licence warning: ${t.warning}"; exit 1; }; cd web && timeout 300 npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1

name: lic01-http
check: grep -qF 'problems?: string[]' web/src/api/http.ts || { echo "error: web/src/api/http.ts: missing problems?: string[]"; exit 1; }; grep -qF 'warning: w.problems?.length ? w.problems.join("; ") : undefined' web/src/api/http.ts || { echo "error: web/src/api/http.ts: missing warning: w.problems?.length ? w.problems.join(; ) : undefined"; exit 1; }; cd web && timeout 300 npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1

name: lic01-mock

name: lic01-spec
check: f=web/tests/workflows.spec.ts; for s in 'toHaveText("licence warning")' 'licence warning: sd15.ckpt: CreativeML OpenRAIL-M: OpenRAIL licence, check its use restrictions' 'Apache-2.0 · on a770, rx9070' 'warnings, GPUs and run numbers'; do grep -qF "$s" $f || { echo "error: $f: missing $s"; exit 1; }; done; grep -q refused $f && { echo "error: $f: still expects refused"; exit 1; }; exit 0
